observation.visible_scene: Two adults are seated in a pool or hot tub against a dark wooden wall. The woman on the left wears a teal bikini top and holds a watermelon slice; the man on the right is shirtless and holds an orange-skinned fruit slice. Both are partially submerged, and the clip shows them smiling, moving their mouths, gesturing, and looking toward each other.
visible_changes: The woman initially holds the watermelon slice with both hands near her face, then mainly supports it with one hand while her other hand rises and later lowers.
The watermelon slice shifts from the center-left of the frame toward the left edge and later appears higher relative to the woman's face.
The woman's expression changes from closed-eye smiling to looking toward the man, pursing her mouth, and then opening her mouth as if speaking or laughing.
The man keeps the fruit slice near his nose and mouth for the first part of the excerpt, then lowers it to chest height in the later frames.
The man's gaze changes from closed/smiling to looking toward the woman, and his mouth moves during the latter part of the clip.
Water ripples and surface reflections continue throughout, and a brighter haze or steam-like effect becomes more noticeable in the later frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the fruit pieces were bitten or eaten before or after this cropped segment.
The content of any conversation or whether the people are actively eating versus holding fruit.
Whether the apparent framing change is caused by camera motion or by the people moving their arms and bodies.
uncertain_details: The exact identity of the man's fruit slice is uncertain.
